Out here,

Three centuries ago humanity crossed the Outer Rim and found the Rift, a wound where reality thins to nothing. What seeps through hunts the energy cores of our stations, and only the Concord's outposts on its edge stand in the way. Their crews called the service the Voidwatch; most never came home, and you are its last active commander.
